content: Choose not to be harmed—and you won't feel harmed. Don't feel harmed—and you haven't been.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. From childhood, we are trained to fit in, to smooth over our eccentricities, and to mirror the expectations of those around us. But copying others only buys superficial acceptance at the cost of your own soul.

Across his life and work, Marcus Aurelius saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Your unique perspective and lived contradictions are your greatest offering to the world. The moment you stop performing and stand firmly in your own skin, you command an authority that imitation can never manufacture.
reflectionPrompt: What current difficulty or obstacle are you facing that could become your greatest training ground?
